title: Jesus... I Thanked You Early And It Felt Fake 🙏
topic: she thanked God in advance for an answer she is still waiting on, and the thank you felt like a transaction

bible.text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I thanked You early. And it felt fake. 🙏

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I said thank You before the result, like a deposit. Then I kept checking if it bought anything.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You weren't buying anything. Gratitude isn't a transaction with Me. You were trusting Me before the proof.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But I felt nothing when I said it. Doesn't that make it worthless?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then say an honest one now. Two honest words outweigh a polished performance.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I'm not waiting for the answer to deserve your thanks. The reaching itself is the offering.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone whose thank you feels small tonight. 🙏
